usage.summary:
Added [conformance.ts](/var/folders/fz/s3p17rl97r30y73d180fjbmc0000gn/T/invariant-synth-2932433023/conformance.ts) and adjusted two safe model paths. Production code and ratified definitions remain unchanged.

Model checks pass; **conformance fails**. The gate caught an IndexedDB open error taking `open → markEmpty` with `localItems = {1}` and `shared = {}`. The subsequent completion flag would violate `CompletionRequiresAllShared` and prevent retry.

I stopped model changes at that bug. The gate remains failing pending the separate code fix.

pins.name: Spec
pins.says: Each browser load follows the modeled migration steps within the checked bounds.

pins.name: DeleteOnlyWhenShared
pins.says: Deletion of the old database is requested only when every original local item is present in the shared library under the same kind and name.

pins.name: CompletionRequiresAllShared
pins.says: The completion flag is never set while any original local item is still absent from the shared library.

pins.name: CompletedLoadsQuiet
pins.says: A load that starts with the completion flag makes no upload, flag-write, or database-deletion attempt.

pins.name: NoStorageWork
pins.says: When reading local storage is unavailable, migration makes no upload, flag-write, or database-deletion attempt.

pins.name: NoAbsentLibraryCopy
pins.says: A browser with no old database uploads no items and requests no database deletion.

pins.name: UploadOnlyNewKeys
pins.says: An item is read for upload only if the shared-library listing lacks its exact kind and name.

pins.name: TypeOK
pins.says: All stored values, migration phases, item sets, and observed operation counts stay within their declared types and bounds.

pins.name: CopiedAndCompleted
pins.says: Migration can upload local items, mark completion, and request deletion after every local item is shared.

pins.name: AlreadySharedCompleted
pins.says: Migration can finish without uploads when every local item already exists under its kind and name.

pins.name: LaterLoadQuiet
pins.says: A second load after completion can return without making any further writes.

pins.name: AbsentLibrarySkipped
pins.says: A load with no old database can record completion without uploading or deleting anything.

pins.name: AbsentStorageSkipped
pins.says: A load without readable local storage can return without writing anything.

pins.name: EmptyLibraryCompleted
pins.says: An existing empty local database can be marked complete and scheduled for deletion without uploads.

pins.name: UnreadableRetained
pins.says: An item with unreadable bytes can remain local with migration still eligible for a later load.

pins.name: FailedUploadRetained
pins.says: An item whose upload failed can remain local with migration still eligible for a later load.

pins.name: FailedItemRetried
pins.says: A second load can attempt to read an item left uncopied by a first-load read or upload failure.

pins.name: MetadataFailureRetained
pins.says: A metadata-read failure can leave an incomplete local library intact and unmarked for a later load.

pins.name: DeleteIncomplete
pins.says: Migration requests deletion while at least one local item has no shared copy.

pins.name: CompleteDespiteUnreadableBytes
pins.says: Migration proceeds to mark completion after silently skipping an unreadable item that has no shared copy.

pins.name: CompleteDespiteUploadFailure
pins.says: Migration proceeds to mark completion even though an upload failed and the item is still absent from the shared library.

pins.name: WriteAfterCompletion
pins.says: A later load writes the completion flag again despite finding it already set.
